source_zh: FDC 與 SPC 關聯分析
suspected_root_cause: RF match drift with chamber polymer buildup and possible ESC helium leak
suspected_root_cause_zh: RF 匹配漂移伴隨腔體聚合物堆積，且可能存在 ESC 氦氣洩漏
containment: Hold WAFERLOT-7782 for CD-SEM review and block release to implant until disposition.
containment_zh: 暫停 WAFERLOT-7782 以進行 CD-SEM 審查，並在處置前禁止放行到離子植入站點。
automated_actions: Create a draft equipment diagnostic report for ETCH-07B.
Open a draft eDHR annotation linking WAFERLOT-7782, SPC drift, and FDC trace IDs.
Notify shift lead, equipment engineering, process engineering, and production control.
automated_actions_zh: 建立 ETCH-07B 的設備診斷報告草稿。
建立 eDHR 註記草稿，連結 WAFERLOT-7782、SPC 漂移與 FDC trace ID。
通知班別主管、設備工程、製程工程與生產管制。
resolution_candidates: Run monitor wafer after chamber clean and RF match verification.
Qualify ETCH-09B with golden recipe before rerouting expedite lots.
Escalate to hold-disposition meeting if CD-SEM confirms out-of-control drift.
resolution_candidates_zh: 在腔體清潔與 RF match 驗證後執行 monitor wafer。
在轉派急件批次前，以 golden recipe 驗證 ETCH-09B。
若 CD-SEM 確認失控漂移，升級到 hold-disposition 會議。
blocked_actions: Do not change recipe parameters automatically.
Do not release wafer lots from quality hold automatically.
Do not put ETCH-07B into maintenance downtime without human approval.
blocked_actions_zh: 不得自動變更 recipe 參數。
不得自動將晶圓批次從品質暫停中放行。
不得在沒有人工作業核准的情況下將 ETCH-07B 轉入維護停機。
approval_required: Equipment engineer approval required before chamber intervention.
Process engineer approval required before recipe or route changes.
Quality owner approval required before lot release.
approval_required_zh: 腔體介入前需要設備工程師核准。
變更 recipe 或路線前需要製程工程師核准。
晶圓批次放行前需要品質負責人核准。
